open_problem_before.title: All-degree Gaussian structure and valid vanishing transfers
open_problem_before.scope: Classify exceptional balanced-support pure-null coefficient loci within precisely stated architectures, separating GMC-safe Gaussian conjugacies from persistent mixed failures; identify hypotheses controlling incomparable radial degrees, independently audit reusable analytic period/seed transfers, and prove valid lower-order transfers or whole-architecture obstructions preserving dimension, differential order, harmonicity and rank-one/separability. GMCDEGREEBARRIER20261115 excludes degree-independent finite pure tests and degree-free mixed constants; GMCSUPPORT20261115 closes support-universal and generic nullity. Neither closes the specialized exceptional locus. General GMC is already false in dimension3 from degree4; do not seek a false unrestricted theorem. FWT1/PSMT1 retain one radial variable; G3AFFINEW20261114 is a complete all-degree architecture; GWNONSING20261114 remains independently unreviewed analytically. DVG1/DVG4/SIC2C4 retain exact operator-order and separability boundaries. User priority is structural progress across degrees and dimensions; further fixed-cubic numeric refinements are secondary. The qualitative cubic theorem remains internally closed; its least-prefix and assurance questions remain separately open. MVLOGCURVE20261115 supplies an internal all-degree logarithmic curve-period criterion: arbitrary rational phase and finitely many moving punctures on P1,full logarithmic form with bounded residues and decaying normalization; also arbitrary-genus finite covers when both phase and form descend. The seed-submodule bridge passes its scope audit with local analytic rather than global rational extension. Analytic action-filtration/growth remains independently unreviewed. Next seek exact Gaussian eliminations meeting this criterion; no new GMC family or cubic numeric change is claimed.
